card.name: Words inside breast cancer chemotherapy phrases
card.fires_on: Linking words and word parts in breast cancer chemotherapy sentences, such as 'prior' before chemotherapy, 'with' or 'receiving' after 'breast cancer', and parts of drug names like cyclophosphamide.

modes.label: Words after breast cancer
modes.description: Small words such as prior, with, receiving or of that follow breast cancer or chemotherapy and lead into a treatment.
